description: Hand-authored ground-truth labels for the redacted TypeSafe evaluation sessions in ./sessions. Rebuild evidence with scripts/build-typesafe-eval-set.cjs; that script never touches this file.

rubric.intent: Primary user goal across the whole session. implement = build or change code/files; debug = diagnose and fix a reported failure; plan = produce a plan or design without implementing; question = informational answer; release = commit, package, version, or publish; analyze = analyze saved chat sessions; automation = unattended agent run (Kanban pickup, auto-review); chitchat = greetings or model small talk.
rubric.routeIntent: TYPESAFE_AI_PLAN.md Phase 2 Choice for the opening user prompt as if sent to @session-control without a slash command: resume | list | analyze | implement | none. General coding requests are none because @session-control does not handle them.
rubric.worthAnalyzing: true when running the saved-session analysis would plausibly surface an AI-control-file lesson (user corrections, repeated 'still broken' reports, instruction violations, or repeated tool failures). Phase 3 recall is measured against this label.
rubric.friction: 0 = smooth; 1 = one clarification or minor correction; 2 = several corrections or a repeated 'still not working' report; 3 = repeated corrections, reverts, or explicit frustration across many turns.
rubric.toolFailureLoops: 0 = no failing tool or command calls; 1 = isolated failures recovered immediately; 2 = the same failure repeated two or three times before resolution; 3 = four or more failing cycles or an unresolved failure loop.
rubric.trivial: true when the session is too short or off-topic to be worth analyzing (greetings, single lookups, unattended auto-review).
